items.briefing:
A new MinterEllison report reveals that 71% of Australian organisations experienced a cyber incident in the past year, with AI being a key driver of more sophisticated attacks. This aligns with separate findings showing ecommerce fraud pressure has risen 33%, largely fuelled by AI-powered scams and identity fraud. Australian lenders are also being flagged for gaps in AI and data readiness, leaving them potentially exposed.

For everyday staff, the main takeaway is that online scams and fraud attempts are becoming harder to spot because criminals are using AI to make them look more convincing. **If you receive an unexpected request to verify your identity or payment details — whether by email, SMS, or phone — always confirm through an official channel before responding.**

featured.title: Cyber incidents hit 71% of Australian organisations as AI reshapes the threat landscape, MinterEllison report
featured.quote: 71% of Australian organisations hit by cyber incidents as AI reshapes threat landscape.
